excerpt.zh: 储备即将耗尽。船组小队将前往星球表面寻找备件、原材料，以及飞船制造机在几个周期前就已停止生产的各类补给品。
excerpt.en: Stores are running low. Crew teams will go planetside to source replacement parts, raw materials, and the supplies the ship's fabricators stopped producing cycles ago.
